name: ISO 42001
description: Management system standard for artificial intelligence (AIMS).

questions.question: Has the organization determined the context and scope of its AI management system?
questions.whyItMatters: This control establishes a foundational requirement; auditors verify both design and operating effectiveness.
questions.guidance: Request the current approved policy, confirm management sign-off and review date, and test that it has been communicated to relevant staff.
probes: When was this last reviewed and by whom?
